x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Update set 1: ITSM_Foundation_<client>_v1 (global) - Transform maps, data sources and scheduled imports (users, groups, locations, departments) - Group types Update set 2: ITSM_Process_<client>_v1 (global) - Incident categories, assignment rules, data lookups, on-hold reasons - SLA definitions and schedules - Change models, risk assessment, CAB definitions, standard change templates - Knowledge base configuration and workflow - Notifications Update set 3: ITSM_Catalog_<client>_v1 (global or app scope) - Catalogue items, variables, variable sets, categories - Flows and subflows Update set 4: ITSM_Experience_<client>_v1 (global) - Portal theme, workspace variants, list/form layouts, reports and dashboards Data (not update sets): users, groups and members, CSDM services/offerings, open-ticket migration — loaded by import set in each environment.
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.data: {"kind": "checklist", "purpose": "Configuration captured in four update sets so foundation, process, catalogue and experience can be reviewed and promoted independently.", "prereqs": null, "rollback": null}
